text:
Mia (AE): Quick sync — Acme POC. Legal just sent MSA/DPA redlines + a security questionnaire. Need pricing credit confirmation and the signing path. Attaching order form in thread.

Samir (SE): Got it. What level of logging/KMS did they require? Olga flagged 'key rotation' and 'no export' in the QA.

Bryan (Legal): Reviewed redlines. Two blockers: 1) They request customer-managed keys — we can offer HSM addendum but need dual-control for emergency access. 2) Broad indemnity carveout for third-party models; propose limit to gross negligence. I'll draft language.

Jane (Finance): POC credit options: we can offer $25k for a 6-week POC if they prepay (net30) and countersign the orderform. If they want month-to-month billing reduce to $15k. Which do we prefer?

Mia (AE): Customer prefers prepay + PO. Can we make $25k conditional on countersigned MSA? Also they want multi-entity invoicing/escrow language.

Samir (SE): From technical side, lock model config + throughput targets in SOW. Also propose a canary fallback clause: if Dedicated capacity isn't available on day 1, automatic fallback to Hosted with throttling and agreed SLAs.

Olga (Security): Security QA mostly accepted except data residency — they require EU-only processing. We can support via region pinning (Private deployment). Need to send SOC2 report and KMS/HSM attestation. HSM addendum required.

Mia (AE): @Bryan can you run the HSM addendum by them? @Jane please iterate the orderform: add 'prepay net30', invoice to 'Acme Biotech Ltd', and a PO number field.

Bryan (Legal): Will send a redline this afternoon. One note: we shouldn't accept unconditional 'customer-managed keys' — propose 'customer-managed keys with operator emergency access under dual-control and audit logging'. ETA 4pm PT.

docusign-bot: Envelope created: orderform_acme_3387654321. Waiting for Mia to upload countersigned MSA.

Mia (AE): Uploading draft MSA redline now. @Bryan please review before I send to customer. @Jane I'll need billing contact to attach PO template.

Jane (Finance): Updated the orderform: invoice contact added + net30. Attached sample invoice and PO template. I'll hold billing account creation until countersign.

Mia (AE): :thumbsup: Plan: Bryan redlines HSM addendum -> I send to Acme -> they sign orderform via DocuSign -> Jane sets up billing -> Olga sends SOC2 + KMS attestation. Any blockers?

Bryan (Legal): No blockers on my end. I'll add the emergency access language and push the redline by 4pm.

Olga (Security): I'll prepare SOC2 PDF and HSM attestation, will send after redline accepted.

Mia (AE): Thanks everyone. Looping in customer contact now: acmeprocure@example.com. I'll ping them once Bryan's language is in. Closing loop unless new blockers pop up.
